{"hypotheses": [
{"name": "Composite 1", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high book-to-market ratios and low accruals tend to outperform, but this effect is amplified when combined with a measure of earnings consistency, as it indicates a more stable financial foundation.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "BM"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "Accruals"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "EarningsConsistency"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "BM", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},
{"name": "Composite 2", 
"mechanism": "The combination of high intangible assets and low operating leverage leads to outperformance, as it suggests a firm with a strong competitive position and low financial risk.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "IntanBM"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "OPLeverage"}], "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 18},
{"name": "Composite 3", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high R&D expenditures and low net debt financing tend to outperform, as they are investing in their future growth while maintaining a healthy financial position.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "RD"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "NetDebtFinance"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "micro", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "RD", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 30},
{"name": "Composite 4", 
"mechanism": "The combination of high earnings consistency and low idiosyncratic volatility leads to outperformance, as it indicates a firm with a stable financial foundation and low risk.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "EarningsConsistency"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "IdioVol3F"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "opposite_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 12},
{"name": "Composite 5", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high sales growth and low operating accruals tend to outperform, as they are experiencing strong revenue growth while maintaining a healthy financial position.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "GrSaleToGrInv"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "PctTotAcc"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "GrSaleToGrInv", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.85, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 20},
{"name": "Composite 6", 
"mechanism": "The combination of high intangible assets and high R&D expenditures leads to outperformance, as it suggests a firm with a strong competitive position and a focus on innovation.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "IntanBM"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "RD"}], "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.75, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 15},
{"name": "Composite 7", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high earnings consistency and low net operating assets tend to outperform, as they are experiencing stable financial performance while maintaining a healthy balance sheet.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "EarningsConsistency"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "NOA"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "micro", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "EarningsConsistency", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 25},
{"name": "Composite 8", 
"mechanism": "The combination of high sales growth and low idiosyncratic volatility leads to outperformance, as it indicates a firm with strong revenue growth and low risk.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "GrSaleToGrInv"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "IdioVolAHT"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "opposite_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 18}
]}
